scenario_name: Listening Session Review Packet — BuildRight Contract Negotiation
description: An Iron Ear listening session captures a contract negotiation call. The session is packaged into a review packet with extracted observations, action items, and kernel routing hints. All outputs are UNTRUSTED until typed by sovereign kernels.

review_packet.summary: Negotiation call regarding amendment to BuildRight consulting contract. Key topics: rate increase request, indemnification cap, and insurance requirements. Counterparty counsel pushed for 8% rate increase; internal counsel countered with 4% tied to CPI.

key_topics.summary: BuildRight requesting 8% rate increase from $165/hr to $178/hr. Internal position is 4% CPI-linked increase to $172/hr. Gap of $6/hr across estimated 2000 hours annually = $12,000 annual impact.
Counterparty wants to reduce indemnification cap from 24 months to 12 months of fees. Internal position is to maintain 24 months given data processing risk profile.
Discussion of increasing minimum professional liability insurance from $2M to $5M. Counterparty indicated this would increase their overhead, may request fee offset.

extracted_action_items.action: Model financial impact of 4% vs 8% rate increase across projected hours for next 3 years
Draft revised indemnification clause maintaining 24-month cap with narrowed scope as compromise
Research market standard for professional liability insurance in construction consulting
Schedule follow-up call with BuildRight counsel for next week
